sovereign_country.strategic_role: 泛欧数字贸易门户、极速低成本在线设立与新锐EMI银行开户

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Lightweight Ad-Monetized Mobile Games

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law legal system with Offshore Special Territory tax characteristics; applicable to both Gibraltar and Bermuda as British Overseas Territories)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: UK-Gibraltar Double Taxation Agreement (1970, as amended; updated 2018 Protocol)
UK-Bermuda Double Taxation Agreement (signed 22 November 2019, in force 2020)
UK-Gibraltar Tax Cooperation Arrangement (2019, incorporating CRS and FATCA IGA reporting)
OECD/G20 BEPS Inclusive Framework (extended to Gibraltar and Bermuda via UK territorial application)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Bermuda (incorporation jurisdiction): Proceeds of Crime Act 1997; Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Regulations 2008 (as amended 2021); Beneficial Ownership Amendment Act 2017; Companies Act 1981. Gibraltar (operational jurisdiction): Proceeds of Crime Act 2015; AML/CFT Regulations 2018; Beneficial Ownership (Companies) Regulations 2017; Economic Substance Act 2018; Sanctions Act 2020; Gibraltar Financial Services Commission Guidance Notes (non-gambling hyper-casual publishing does not require a gambling licence under the Gambling Act 2005 regime).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Apostille issued by the Bermuda Registry General)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum of Association and Bye-Laws (duly executed and notarized)
Certificate of Good Standing / Due Diligence Certificate
UBO Declaration and Beneficial Ownership Register Extract (form BO-1)
Certified Passport Copies and Proof of Residential Address of each Director and Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing government authority (passport) and CSP (address verification)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory one-time onboarding screening and continuous real-time batch screening (minimum every 24 hours) of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, signatories and commercial counterparties against: UN Consolidated List, UK HMT Consolidated Sanctions List, EU CFSP Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, Gibraltar FSC Sanctions Notices, and domestic terrorism watchlists. Any PEP identification automatically triggers Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) requiring senior management approval, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation, and 6-monthly enhanced reviews. Screening for AdMob and AppLovin payouts must also align with Google and AppLovin publisher compliance policies.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Companies House Gibraltar (operated by the Registrar of Companies, HM Government of Gibraltar; online e-filing portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English only. Corporate names must be rendered in Latin script (Standard English alphabet); no transliteration from native scripts is permitted for the primary legal name. Every limited company name must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd'. Names must not be identical, phonetic homophones, or misleadingly similar to any existing registered name in Gibraltar or an overseas company registered in Gibraltar. For the Bermuda Exempted Company branch registration, the Gibraltar branch must be registered under the exact parent name; if trading under a different name, a Gibraltar 'business name' application is required.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection the applicant may: (1) submit an administrative review request to the Registrar of Companies within 14 working days citing Section 3(2) of the Companies Act 2014 and demonstrating no confusing similarity or undesirability; (2) if administratively denied, file a fresh name reservation application with a revised corporate name and payment of the standard fee; (3) initiate a formal appeal through the Supreme Court of Gibraltar by way of judicial review within 30 days of final refusal, applying the Wednesday unreasonableness standard. The 30-day reservation may be extended once for an additional 14 days upon written justification and payment of the prescribed extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office services are accepted only as supplemental mail-forwarding arrangements and cannot satisfy the statutory registered office requirement in either jurisdiction. The Bermuda Exempted Company must maintain a physical registered office in Bermuda (Bermuda Companies Act 1981, Section 33) and, upon registration as an overseas company in Gibraltar, a physical residential/office address in Gibraltar (Companies Act 2014, Section 8). Both physical addresses may be supplied by licensed corporate service providers (CSPs).
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium risk (30-40%) of unannounced on-site inspection within the first 12 months. The Gibraltar Economic Substance Act 2018 and the Bermuda Economic Substance Amendment Act 2019 both mandate substantive core income-generating activities, management presence, and proportionate expenditure in the respective territory. Digital advertising payout volumes (AdMob/AppLovin) may trigger FSC monitoring and inspection protocol for e-commerce businesses with high transaction throughput.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bermuda Exempted Company incorporation fee (government filing and certificate)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory government tariff under the Companies Act 1981

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Gibraltar overseas company (branch) registration filing for Bermuda Exempted Company
Gibraltar name clearance and reservation fee
Notarization of incorporation documents, bye-laws and UBO declarations (Bermuda)
Hague Apostille certification (6 documents issued by Bermuda Registry General)
UBO register filing and retention (Bermuda BO register and Gibraltar BO register filings)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Bermuda Registrar of Companies / Gibraltar Companies Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory compliance filing fee per jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bermuda registered office and licensed CSP services (Year 1)
Gibraltar registered office and licensed CSP services (Year 1)
PEP, OFAC, UN, HMT, EU and Gibraltar FSC sanctions screening (one-time KYC/AML package)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Gibraltar licensed CSP / AML compliance officer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Cross-border legal advisory and structuring counsel (Bermuda-Gibraltar dual jurisdiction)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External legal counsel (admitted in both jurisdictions)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed fee engagement or hourly billing market benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Bermuda Companies Act 1981 (ss. 4, 4A, 4B, 8, 129) as the primary lex incorporationis for the Exempted Company; Gibraltar Companies Act 2014 (Part 10, ss. 218-237) for registration of the Bermuda Exempted Company as an external company; Income Tax (International Holding Companies) Act 2022 (Gibraltar) available where the corporate group elects qualifying exempt status.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (Ministry of Finance); Companies House Gibraltar, Financial Services Commission, HM Government of Gibraltar.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Bermuda Certificate of Incorporation (Exempted Company) together with Memorandum of Association, Bye-laws and Certificate of Exemption; Gibraltar Form GC-01 (External Company Registration) with certified constitutional documents and Gibraltar registered agent consent.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital in Bermuda; authorized capital is customarily USD 12,000 (e.g., 12,000 ordinary shares of USD 1.00 each) with unlimited subscribed but unpaid flexibility; no escrow or deposit account is required for an exempted company; Gibraltar external branch registration also carries no minimum capital requirement, but a Gibraltar-resident registered agent and local registered office are mandatory.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: 1. The subscription of 12,000 ordinary shares of USD 1.00 each in the share capital of the Company by the founding subscriber is hereby approved, and the Directors are authorized to issue certificates and record allotments in the statutory register; 2. The registered office of the Company at the office of its Gibraltar registered agent is hereby confirmed as the legal address for all statutory communications and service of process; 3. [Name] is hereby appointed Company Secretary and [Name] is hereby appointed Chief Financial Officer, each with full authority to open bank and EMI accounts, execute commercial contracts, and file registry notices; 4. All ancillary delegations are ratified. This resolution is effective immediately and binds all members.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda Registrar of Companies online registry portal; Gibraltar Companies House name index via the Financial Services Commission.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request to the Bermuda Registry and concurrently screen the Gibraltar external-company register for identical or confusingly similar names. Reject prohibited markers (e.g., 'Royal', 'Trust', 'Assurance') and confirm the proposed name is acceptable for a Gibraltar external company registration.
required_dossiers: Completed name reservation request form
Identity and KYC details of proposed directors and ultimate beneficial owner
Authorized share capital schedule for Bermuda fee classification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or prohibited wording, resubmit with an alternate name; a formal reconsideration letter may be lodged with the Bermuda Registrar within 14 days at no additional government fee for the first re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Bermuda corporate services provider and Bermuda Notary Public for subscriber attestation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association and Bye-laws in English including the statutory declaration under s. 4B of the Bermuda Companies Act 1981 that the company will not carry on business in Bermuda unless licensed; include share class rights, board powers, and non-resident ownership provisions; arrange notarization of subscriber signatures and delivery of certified copies for Gibraltar filing.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association executed by subscribers
Bye-laws (articles) executed
Declaration of Exempted Status / Permit to Exempt from Trading under s. 129
Consent of Bermuda registered office provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries missing exempted-status declarations, amend and resubmit within five business days; expedited 24-hour review is available upon payment of a priority processing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bermuda Incorporation Filing and Certificate Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda, Court Street, Hamilton.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the full incorporation package through the Bermuda registry gateway or by courier, pay the exempted-company government fee, and obtain the executed Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Exemption, and company register bundle. Confirm the appointed Bermuda resident agent appears on the certificate.
required_dossiers: Approved name reservation confirmation
Notarized Memorandum of Association and Bye-laws
Statement of authorized share capital
Bermuda registered office consent and resident representative form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fee assessment or capital schedule is disputed, provide a revised fee calculation to the Registry cashier; alternatively accept standard five-day processing with no penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Gibraltar External Company Registration (Part 10, Companies Act 2014)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies House Gibraltar, Financial Services Commission.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 28 days of the Bermuda incorporation date, file Form GC-01 together with certified English-language copies (apostilled) of the Bermuda Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Bye-laws; appoint a Gibraltar-resident registered agent and adopt a local registered office; pay the Gibraltar external-company registration fee.
required_dossiers: Form GC-01 (External Company Registration)
Apostilled certified copy of the Bermuda Certificate of Incorporation
Certified true copy of Bermuda Memorandum and Bye-laws
Consent letter from Gibraltar registered agent
List of directors, company secretary and ultimate beneficial owner control schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If Companies House issues a discrepancy query (e.g., director list mismatch), respond by sworn statutory declaration within 10 working days; if the 28-day statutory deadline is near, apply in writing for an administrative extension before lapse.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Governance Kit and Statutory Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (internal corporate act); Gibraltar registered agent as statutory records custodian.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or obtain a unanimous written resolution adopting the share subscriptions, registered office, and officer appointments as set out in the pro-forma resolution; open the statutory registers (members, directors, secretary, charges, UBO register) and establish the minute book at the Gibraltar registered agent.
required_dossiers: Signed First Board Resolution
Share certificate application and allotment letters
Register of members and share ledger
Registers of charges and guarantees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a filing timestamp is missed, re-certify the omission by unanimous written resolution; Gibraltar Companies House accepts a correcting statutory declaration to regularize the record date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Tax, AML and Data Protection Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Income Tax Office (Commissioner of Income Tax); Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit; Gibraltar Data Protection Commissioner.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Notify the Gibraltar Income Tax Office of the company's foreign-incorporation status under the Income Tax Act 2010 and, where qualifying, file an International Holding Company election; submit FATCA/CRS financial-institution registration; register as a data controller under GDPR for the hyper-casual gaming data flows; file AML compliance manual with outsourced compliance officer.
required_dossiers: Gibraltar tax registration form (GSTAX-1)
CRS/FATCA financial institution application
Data controller registration form
AML/KYB compliance manual and appointed compliance officer letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the IHC election is rejected on eligibility grounds, fall back to territorial taxation with a standard tax return; late data-protection registration is regularized by a backdating letter from the Commissioner upon payment of an administrative filing charge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial, Fire Safety and Occupancy Clearances for the Gibraltar Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Health and Safety at Work Inspectorate, HM Government of Gibraltar; Gibraltar Fire and Rescue Service; Department of the Environment and Climate Change.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Given the pure digital-publishing footprint, submit an occupancy notification for the Gibraltar office or flex-space, obtain a fire risk assessment certificate and electrical installation load certificate for any fit-out works, and designate WEEE-compliant electronic waste disposal channels for office ICT hardware; no environmental impact assessment is triggered.
required_dossiers: Office occupancy notification form
Fire safety certificate and fire risk assessment summary
Electrical installation load certificate (where fit-out applies)
WEEE disposal and data-sanitization contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an inspection identifies non-compliance (e.g., incomplete escape-route mapping), submit a remedial action plan within 21 days and obtain a re-inspection certificate from the Fire and Rescue Service before occupancy proceeds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Gibraltar Regulatory Authority (GRA), Digital Services Directorate; trade licensing on the Gibraltar Business Licensing Act 2014 applies only to physical retail or regulated sectors and is not applicable to software publishing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required — hyper-casual ad-monetized mobile game publishing is an unregulated digital activity in Gibraltar; a voluntary Gibraltar Digital Operator Registration certificate may be obtained from the GRA for banking and partner due-diligence comfort.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment and Climate Change, HM Government of Gibraltar.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 5 (De Minimis) — office-only digital publisher; no full EIA Report required under the Environmental (Impact Assessment) Regulations 2023 and no sectoral screening certificate is triggered for serverless/cloud-hosted operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial trade effluent or VOC emissions; office sanitary discharge must meet Gibraltar Water (Effluent) limits with zero trade effluent; WEEE disposal under the Gibraltar Waste Management Regulations 2016 with data-destroyed hardware; packaging waste registration applies only to imported physical dev test units; server workloads must be hosted in EU Tier IV data centers under energy-efficiency contracts.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificates and structural load assessments required for any leased Gibraltar office through the Gibraltar Fire and Rescue Service and Building Survey Unit; electrical installation clearance from the Gibraltar Electricity Authority; occupational health screening under the Health and Safety at Work Act; emergency-plan module registration with Civil Defence Gibraltar for business continuity and 24/7 incident response.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Her Majesty's Revenue & Customs (HMRC) for UK VAT administration; Gibraltar Income Tax Office (GITO) for Gibraltar local tax identity. HMRC portal: https://www.gov.uk/vat; Gibraltar portal: https://www.gibraltar.gov.gi/tax
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For UK VAT: Non-Established Taxable Person (NETP) applies to HMRC on Form VAT1; non-established suppliers of digital services to UK consumers may register via the VAT One Stop Shop (OSS) portal. For Gibraltar: a foreign company (including a Bermuda Exempted Company) registers at the Gibraltar Companies Registry under the Foreign Companies Act, obtains a certificate of registration, and files Form TAX1 with the Income Tax Office to secure a Gibraltar Tax Reference Number (TRN). No VAT registration in Gibraltar is required because Gibraltar does not operate a VAT regime.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Gibraltar: election for 'prescribed company' status under the Income Tax (Prescribed Companies) Rules and group relief elections under the Income Tax Act. UK: no check-the-box election is available for foreign entities; hybrid mismatch treatment is reviewable under the UK Finance Act 2016 and Gibraltar's ATAD implementation to eliminate double non-taxation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (United Kingdom); Gibraltar applies import duty on physical goods only and does not levy VAT or a general sales tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: GBP 90,000 for UK-established businesses; no de minimis threshold for non-established businesses supplying digital services to UK consumers (mandatory registration); Gibraltar: no VAT threshold (not applicable)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: UK Making Tax Digital for VAT requires digital record-keeping and API-based submission of VAT returns; e-invoicing is not currently mandated; no real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping is required, except for VAT OSS digital services periodic returns. Gibraltar has no e-invoicing or fiscal clearance mandate.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods may be zero-rated if exported to a non-UK destination within 3 months, with contemporaneous transport and customs evidence. Services, including digital advertising and hyper-casual game publishing services, are outside the scope of UK VAT (and thus effectively zero-rated) when supplied to a customer who belongs outside the UK, subject to evidence of the customer's identity and country of residence. For B2B services the customer's VAT registration number or equivalent must be obtained; for B2C services the location of the recipient is established by payment/billing address and IP geo-location.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD / C78 / CDS electronic acknowledgment)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate (or bank / fintech payment evidence for FX repatriation)
Export invoice and purchase order / contract
For digital services: customer confirmation of non-UK status, IP address validation, payment receipt and internal contract file
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: HMRC may issue a protective VAT assessment up to 20 years for deliberate misstatement; zero-rating can be retrospectively revoked with interest; penalties of up to 100% of the VAT due apply for fraudulent evasion; criminal prosecution may be brought under the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979. Gibraltar Customs may apply forfeiture and value-based fines for export declaration falsehoods or misclassification.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) as the sole prudential and conduct banking regulator; Government of Gibraltar (Ministry of Finance) as issuer of Gibraltar pound banknotes and manager of the statutory 1:1 GBP peg; Bank of England as the de facto anchor monetary authority for the pegged currency. Gibraltar has no independent central bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full current-account and capital-account convertibility. The Gibraltar pound (GIP) is pegged at par to GBP and circulates interchangeably with sterling in the banking system; EUR and USD are freely accepted for settlement. No exchange-control approvals are required for inward investment, dividend distribution, licensing royalties, or intercompany funding. Profit remittance from a Gibraltar-registered foreign company of a Bermuda Exempted Company is unrestricted, with zero withholding tax. The regime complies with IMF Article VIII obligations and retains EU-derived free-movement-of-capital principles.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. No statutory timeline, surrender obligation, or mandatory conversion ratio applies to export proceeds or advertising receivables in Gibraltar or the UK. USD, EUR, and GBP receipts from AdMob/AppLovin may be retained in original currency or converted at treasury discretion. The only compliance overlay is internal AML/CFT record-keeping under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2015 (Gibraltar) and the Sanctions Act 2020 (Gibraltar), requiring retention of underlying invoices, platform payout statements, and commercial contracts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account - GBP multi-currency settlement with Treasury Deposit line
Operational Account - GBP/EUR/USD multi-currency corporate account
Operational Account - GBP with UK Faster Payments connectivity
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account - fiduciary reserve (optional)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: HIGH as an auxiliary collection and FX-conversion spoke, but MEDIUM-LOW as a standalone principal treasury rail. UK FCA-licensed electronic money institutions (Wise Business, Revolut Business, Payoneer) — or EMIs holding a direct GFSC e-money licence — may lawfully service Gibraltar entities under the UK-Gibraltar financial services equivalence framework; EEA EMIs cannot rely on EU passporting into Gibraltar. Payoneer and Wise payout collection for Google AdMob and AppLovin is available. Legal constraints: (i) e-money is not a bank deposit and is not protected by the Gibraltar deposit compensation scheme or UK FSCS, (ii) safeguarding accounts are held at tier-1 banks and are vulnerable to third-party insolvency, and (iii) high-velocity micro-payout settlement or mismatched branding between the EMI account name and the AdMob/AppLovin payee name triggers duplicate onboarding and frequent compliance interventions. Recommended architecture: EMIs operate only as collection spokes for platform payouts; the GFSC-regulated bank account remains the consolidated treasury hub.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is permitted, but all Gibraltar banks require a live video compliance interview with each director, ultimate beneficial owner, and authorised signatory; no statutory or GFSC rule mandating physical attendance exists. In practice, Banco Santander Totta and SG Kleinwort Hambros may require an in-person visit or a certified-legalised document drop at the Gibraltar branch for non-EEA UBO chains; Gibraltar International Bank and Jyske Bank accept video KYC where the corporate documents are attested by a GFSC-regulated advocate, registered agent, or certified accountant. For this Bermuda Exempted Company, the operative mandate is: (i) certified certificate of registration as a foreign company in Gibraltar, (ii) video interview with the compliance officer, (iii) board resolution and banker's mandate executed by all directors, and (iv) attorney-held original share certificate of the Bermuda parent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore parent (Bermuda Exempted Company) with zero minimum capital and pass-through tax profile raising shell-company red flags under enhanced due diligence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Gibraltar foreign-company registration certificate under the Companies Act 2014; Bermuda Economic Substance (ES) compliance certificate or pure-equity-holding exclusion letter under the Economic Substance (Substance Requirements) Order 2018; active Gibraltar office lease or registered-office attestation; board minutes evidencing real management and control; resident director profile and engagement letter; UBO register and corporate structure chart; six months of management accounts reflecting operating expenditure and payroll.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity, low-ticket micro-payments from AdMob and AppLovin resembling money-mule layering or unlicensed payment aggregation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed Google AdSense/AdMob Publisher Agreement and AppLovin Publisher Agreement; six months of platform payout reconciliation reports; Google Play Console and App Store Connect ownership verification; commercial invoices matching each payout cycle; IFRS 15 revenue-recognition narrative; whitelist of all payment sub-processors with their own licences and KYC certifications.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border mismatch between Bermuda legal seat, Gibraltar collection base, and US/EU payors creating tax-evasion or sanctions-exposure suspicion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bermuda tax-exempt certificate from the Government of Bermuda; legal opinion on tax residence and permanent establishment nexus; transfer-pricing policy for intercompany ad-licensing and IP royalties; OFAC/HMT/EU consolidated sanctions screening output with timestamps; CRS self-certification and CbCR notifications; shareholder and RBO/PSC register filed with the Gibraltar Registrar of Companies.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FX hedging and third-party beneficiary payments to gaming-ecosystem accounts being misclassified as unlawful gambling or payment-laundering flows.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statutory licence-waiver confirmation for non-wagering hyper-casual games under the Gibraltar Gambling Act 2005; approved-beneficiary whitelist for all outbound virements; treasury hedging policy and board-approved counterparty list; SAR framework and transaction-monitoring rationale; compliance attestation from each receiving bank or EMI serving the beneficiary.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For a zero-minimum-capital Exempted Company, injections are routed as SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's licensed bank to the Gibraltar settlement account using ISO 20022 purpose code SUBS (share subscription) or CINL (capital increase), with field 70 stating 'Share capital subscription per board resolution [date]' and the company CRS/GIIN reference. The complying file pack comprises: executed board resolution, allotment form, updated register of members, source-of-wealth documentation of the UBO, and CRS self-certification; injections exceeding GBP 100,000 equivalent trigger EDD and may require a confirmation letter from the remitting bank. No exchange-control or GFSC approval is required, but the receiving bank must complete customer due diligence under the Gibraltar AML/CFT framework before credit; capital received is cleared on a T+1 basis and may be held in any currency without surrender.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails: SWIFT MT103/MT202 COV for international trade settlements and USD payouts via the Jyske/Gibraltar International Bank correspondent network; UK Faster Payments (FPS) for GBP disbursements to suppliers and contractors; SEPA Instant for EUR-region payouts; ACH/SWIFT for US payor routes. Commercial Letters of Credit are not applicable to digital advertising transactions, the operative documentary rail being the cross-border MT103 supported by pro-forma invoices and, where required, on-demand payment guarantees under URDG 758. AdMob and AppLovin payouts are received by wire to the designated USD/GBP settlement accounts; intercompany licensing payments to the Bermuda parent and dividend distributions are executed as MT103s with board minutes declaring an interim dividend and, where applicable, corresponding certificates evidencing zero Gibraltar withholding.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright GBP/USD, GBP/EUR, and EUR/USD cash-delivered FX forwards (tenor up to 12 months; documented under ISDA or standard FX confirmation)
FX swaps for rolling USD-denominated AdMob/AppLovin receipts into GBP/EUR operating costs
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) where intercompany loan funding between the Bermuda parent and Gibraltar operations is established
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) permitted for exotic settlement currencies but operationally unnecessary for GIP/GBP given the statutory 1:1 par peg
OTC vanilla FX options (zero-premium collars and cost-reducing structures) purchased exclusively for hedging, subject to the board-approved treasury policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Gibraltar Annual Return for External Company (Form AR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 21 days after the anniversary of the date the Bermuda Exempted Company was registered as a Gibraltar external company.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of GBP 120 escalating with continued default; persistent non-filing exposes the Gibraltar registration to a default fine and administrative strike-off after 3 months of unremedied non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Bermuda Exempted Company Annual Return and Government Fee Remittance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Registrar of Companies (collecting for the Bermuda Ministry of Finance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January in each calendar year, calculated by reference to the Exempted Company's authorized share capital.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default surcharge of BMD 100 per month for late payment; continued non-payment for 90 days may trigger administrative strike-off under the Bermuda Companies Act 1981.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Bermuda Annual Certificate of Compliance and Register Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Required as part of the annual return cycle; must be executed and delivered within 60 days of the 31 January fee due date or by the registry-designated anniversary deadline.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deliver the statutory declaration of compliance may prevent issuance of subsequent certificates of good standing and can result in late-filing penalties of BMD 100 per month.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Bermuda Exempted Company: audit is mandatory where consolidated gross assets exceed BMD 5,000,000 or annual gross receipts exceed BMD 1,000,000, or where the company conducts regulated financial services. Gibraltar external-company branch: independent audit is not compulsory unless the worldwide parent exceeds Gibraltar's Companies Act thresholds, primarily turnover exceeding GBP 10,200,000 or balance sheet total exceeding GBP 5,100,000.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as applied in Gibraltar for branch financial statements; the Bermuda parent may maintain its statutory accounts under IFRS or a recognized equivalent standard.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Bermuda Exempted Company must keep its members' register current at all times; any share transfer is effective only upon entry in the Register of Members and must be recorded within one month of the transfer. At each annual return date, the Bermudian statutory declaration must confirm that the corporate registers are accurate and that no unauthorized share transfers or registrable ownership changes have been omitted. As a Gibraltar external company, the entity's beneficial ownership profile must also be reconfirmed annually at the Companies Registry, with all changes to the register filed within 14 days of occurrence.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holidays exist for hyper-casual game publishing. A Bermuda Exempted Company that is managed and controlled outside Gibraltar and has no Gibraltar permanent establishment (PE) may escape Gibraltar corporate tax entirely on advertising profits. A Gibraltar Qualifying Company (QRC) is taxed at 10% on Gibraltar-source income only and is exempt on foreign ad-revenue, subject to substance conditions. Capital gains fall outside the scope of Gibraltar corporate income tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Gibraltar Form C (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed via the Government of Gibraltar e-Tax portal (eservices.gibraltar.gov.gi)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months of the accounting period end date (default accounting period = calendar year 31 December), unless the Commissioner of Income Tax grants an extension in writing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the company and registered company number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the name as registered with the Bermuda Registrar of Companies and, where applicable, the Gibraltar branch / registered establishment number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Country of incorporation and tax identification number (TIN).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the Bermuda BRN and Gibraltar TIN if a PE exists; if no TIN has been issued, state 'N/A'.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting period start and end dates (DD/MM/YYYY).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the statutory accounting period adopted under Bermuda law (normally 12 months). The Gibraltar return must cover any period during which the company operated through a Gibraltar PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gibraltar tax residency status: Resident or Non-resident.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident companies are assessed only on profits attributable to a Gibraltar PE. To preserve non-resident status, central management and control must be exercised outside Gibraltar (i.e. in Bermuda).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Chargeable profits: gross advertising revenue / game receipts less allowable expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident, include only income attributable to Gibraltar user traffic or a Gibraltar PE. Payments from AdMob and AppLovin must be apportioned on a geographic basis using a defensible revenue-split method.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Capital allowances and losses carried forward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses generated by the Gibraltar trade may be deducted. Losses incurred by the Bermuda head office are not allowable unless they arise from the same trade and can be attributed to the Gibraltar PE under arm's-length principles.
Compute the 10% tax on Gibraltar-source profit. After rounding, claim any foreign tax credits or unilateral relief for foreign withholding tax charged on non-trading income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of GIP 100 plus GIP 15 per day of continued default up to a maximum of GIP 3,000. Where the failure is deliberate, the Commissioner may levy a tax-geared penalty of up to 100% of the understated tax plus interest at 0.5% per month on unpaid tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Gibraltar imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid to non-resident shareholders, including a Bermuda Exempted Company parent.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: As the domestic rate is already 0%, no treaty claim is generally required. Where a treaty reduction is sought (e.g. under the Gibraltar–UK DTA), the beneficial owner must submit a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the Bermuda Ministry of Finance or HMRC, together with Form DWT to the Gibraltar Income Tax Office, confirming entitlement to the jurisdictional relief.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates are 0% for cross-border royalties and interest paid to non-residents. Under the Gibraltar–UK DTA, the rate remains 0% for UK beneficial owners. For ad-network receipts (AdMob/AppLovin), the amounts are generally business profits rather than royalties, so no WHT applies to the service fee; only the underlying user-location profit is assessable to the Gibraltar PE as part of corporate income.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: GIP 500,000 in aggregate related-party transactions triggers a mandatory contemporaneous Local File. Master File documentation is required for Gibraltar group members whose consolidated group revenue exceeds EUR 750,000,000 (approximately GIP 675,000,000).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Gibraltar does not currently operate a standalone Economic Substance Regulation regime, but the ultimate substance obligation sits with the Bermuda Exempted Company under the Bermuda Economic Substance (Corporate Tax) Act 2018. A company holding IP for hyper-casual games must demonstrate a physical presence, employees, and expenditure in Bermuda unless it qualifies for a pure equity holding exemption. If central management and control is found to be in Gibraltar, Gibraltar will deem the company resident and demand tax on worldwide profits. The 'Tax_Exempt_Zone' classification is upheld only where a genuine Bermuda substance core exists and no Gibraltar PE is created.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Holding board meetings by video in Bermuda while all game monetisation, user acquisition, and ad-placement decisions are made in Gibraltar; declaring non-resident status to avoid Gibraltar corporate tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment as a Gibraltar-resident company on worldwide advertising profits at 10%; penalty of up to 100% of the tax due; fine of up to GIP 50,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors signing false residency declarations are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax, subject to disqualification for up to 5 years, and can face a travel ban. Criminal fraud carries imprisonment of up to 2 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating exclusively from a post-office or virtual office with no employees, physical facilities, or commercial equipment, while generating UK/EU user advertising revenue through the Bermuda exempt entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Bermuda ESR penalties range from $10,000 to $250,000 and can result in striking off the company. Gibraltar can issue a winding-up order for non-filing of Form C and late tax penalties up to GIP 25,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors must certify economic substance; continuing to sign false certificates can trigger personal restitution of avoided tax and a travel ban under the Foreign Tax Enforcement Act, in addition to court-imposed director disqualification.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling advertising inventory or mobile-game user data to a Gibraltar affiliate at non-arm's-length prices so that profits accumulate in Bermuda while the Gibraltar entity makes tax-deductible royalty payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Income Tax (Transfer Pricing) Act grants the Commissioner power to reallocate profits to reflect arm's-length outcomes; the adjustment is taxed at 10% with monthly interest at 0.5% and a penalty of 25% of the understatement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The TP return requires officer certification. False documentation or failure to provide the Local File triggers a penalty up to GIP 10,000 per document. Where the scheme is proved fraudulent, directors are personally liable for the tax and may be prosecuted for theft of revenue.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using bearer shares, nominee shareholders, or a chain of shell companies to hide the ultimate beneficial owner of the gaming publishing company while receiving AdMob / AppLovin payouts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Gibraltar Beneficial Ownership (Information) Act, non-disclosure of UBO information is a criminal offence punishable with a fine of up to GIP 500,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 2 years. PSPs may freeze accounts and block payouts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors can be disqualified from acting as directors in Gibraltar for 10 years and fined personally up to GIP 20,000. If funds are laundered, personal accounts may be frozen under the Proceeds of Crime Act, and travel bans are available where the director is outside the jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring dividends out of the Gibraltar operating company to the Bermuda parent without a solvency assessment or while the company has unpaid corporate tax, thus stripping the Gibraltar entity of assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Gibraltar Companies Act prohibits distributions unless the directors issue a solvency statement. An illegal distribution is a criminal offence; the company remains liable for unpaid tax plus interest, and shareholders may be ordered to repay the dividend.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who cosign a solvency statement without reasonable grounds are personally liable for the company's debts and any tax shortfall. The Commissioner may sue for wrongful trading, and a travel ban may be imposed under the Foreign Tax Enforcement Act if assets are moved out of Gibraltar.
